title: Missing a team dinner
passage:
I won't be able to attend the team dinner.
A. Thanks for letting me know; I'll update the reservation. B. The tables have already been cleaned. C. It's usually served with rice.
passageZh:
我沒辦法參加團隊聚餐。
A. 謝謝你告知，我會更新訂位。
B. 桌子已經清潔過了。
C. 它通常搭配米飯供應。
